preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 200,000, and k is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 1000000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The edges form a valid tree structure (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible grade Jacob can achieve.

postconditions.expression: max_grade == max(min(a[node] for node in dfs_prefix) for root in range(1, n+1) for dfs_prefix in all_valid_dfs_prefixes(root, k))
postconditions.description: The maximum grade is the highest minimum value found in the first k nodes of any valid DFS traversal, considering all possible roots and neighbor orderings.
